from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
print(im.shape, im.dtype, im.min(), im.max())
# bounding candidates by orange color
r,g,b=im.transpose(2,0,1)
mask=(r>120)&(r>g*1.35)&(g>b*1.05)&(b<130)
y,x=np.where(mask)

# crate dark bbox
m2=(r<75)&(g<75)&(b<75)
y2,x2=np.where(m2)
print('dark bbox',x2.min(),y2.min(),x2.max(),y2.max())
